question: Which veteran actor and dancer, noted for her appearances in films like ‘Navrang’ and ‘Pinjra’, passed away in October 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandhya Shantaram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The veteran Indian actress and dancer **Sandhya Shantaram**, widely recognized for her prolific work in **Marathi** and **Hindi cinema**, passed away in **October 2025**.
 
• She was particularly celebrated for her lead roles in cinematic masterpieces directed by the legendary filmmaker **V. Shantaram**, such as the musical **Navrang (1959)** and the tragic drama **Pinjra (1972)**.
 
• Born as **Vijaya Deshmukh**, she was discovered by **V. Shantaram** and cast in the film **Amar Bhoopali** in **1951**, marking the beginning of a legendary career spanning several decades.
 
• She was known for her exceptional **classical dance** abilities, which were showcased extensively in films like **Jhalak** and **Do Aankhen Barah Haath (1957)**.
 
• Her performance in **Pinjra** is considered a milestone in **Marathi cinema**, where she played the role of a **Tamasha** dancer who challenges the moral fiber of a village teacher. ***Hence, the correct answer is Sandhya Shantaram.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significant Films:**
 
 
• **Navrang (1959):** This film is famous for its vibrant **Holi** sequences and the iconic song "**Tu Chhupi Hai Kahan**". **Sandhya** played a dual role (real-life wife and the protagonist's muse), showcasing her versatility as an actor and **kathak** dancer.
 
• **Pinjra (1972):** It was the first **Marathi film** to be produced in **color**. The film explored themes of morality, social fall, and the **Lavani** folk dance culture of **Maharashtra**.
 
• **Do Aankhen Barah Haath (1957):** In this socially relevant film about **prison reform**, she played the role of a toy seller, contributing to a project that won the **Silver Bear** at the **Berlin International Film Festival**.
 
 
 
• **Association with Rajkamal Kalamandir:**
 
 
• Most of her work was produced under the banner of **Rajkamal Kalamandir**, one of India's most prestigious film studios located in **Mumbai**.
 
• She married **V. Shantaram** in the **1950s** and remained a core part of his creative vision until his death in **1990**.
 
 
 
• **Legacy in Dance:**
 
 
• Unlike many actors of her era, **Sandhya** performed high-intensity **classical** and **folk dance** sequences without the use of body doubles, often undergoing rigorous training for months to perfect her movements for the **big screen**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **V. Shantaram:** A pioneer of **Indian Cinema**, he was a recipient of the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** in **1985**. His films often focused on **social reform** and **humanism**.
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Jyoti Chandekar:** A well-known **Marathi stage** and film actress, known for her powerful character roles, but she is not the lead associated with **Navrang**.
 
• **Sulakshana Pandit:** An actress and **playback singer** prominent in the **1970s** and **1980s**, known for her roles in **Bollywood** but not primarily for **Shantaram's** early classics.
 
• **Madhumati:** A famous **dancer** and actress in **Hindi cinema** known for her **item numbers** and character roles during the **Golden Era** of the **1960s**.
